issues.subject: OpenAI rolls out GPT-6 with an interactive interface
issues.intro: OpenAI launched GPT-6 with interactive visual elements directly inside ChatGPT. Meanwhile, Anthropic connected Claude to Google Workspace and added interactive dashboards to its web workspace. These releases focus on making everyday assistant workflows faster and more visual without requiring technical setup.

issues.subject: OpenAI DevDay, GPT-6.1 Sol, and Gemini 4 Argon
issues.intro: Major new frontier models launched this week, led by OpenAI's DevDay announcements and the debut of GPT-6.1 Sol and Gemini 4 Argon. These updates bring more capable coding agents and pricing adjustments for everyday users.

issues.subject: Claude Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 launch with price cuts
issues.intro: Anthropic released new flagship models alongside broad industry price drops of forty to fifty percent. Meanwhile, AMD acquired World Labs and GitHub integrated the new models into Copilot.
